question: Among players with at least 10 goals in 2023-2024, who overperformed their xG by the most (goals minus xG)?
answer: Based on the data, Phil Foden overperformed his expected goals (xG) by the most in the 2023-2024 season. He scored 19 goals against an xG of 11.308, resulting in an xG overperformance of 7.692.
sql:
SELECT player_name, goals_pss, xg_pss, (goals_pss - xg_pss) AS xg_overperformance
FROM vw_player_season_summary
WHERE season = '2023-2024'
  AND goals_pss >= 10
ORDER BY xg_overperformance DESC
LIMIT 1;
